text:
maya: Hey team — CI went red on main after the pre-commit/tooling bumps. pyright/typecheck is failing in kvcache; error about 'KeyType' not found. Was anyone touching stubs or typeshed recently?
sam: I saw that. triaging now. Is this from the PR that landed #3421? cc @corey
ci-bot: CI | pipeline/main - failed - pyright -> https://ci.internal/build/12345
Tests failing: pyright-typecheck (kvcache/__init__.py)
corey: I pushed a quick attempt to pin typeshed in a draft PR but it didn't change anything. traceback snippet:
```
kvcache/__init__.py:42: error: Name 'KeyType' is not defined
```
jen: Can we try rerunning the pyright job only? if it's a transient cache issue a rerun will tell us. /rerun pyright
sam: rerun queued — fyi there's also a rustfmt pre-commit warning in a separate shard but that's unrelated to this failure
ci-bot: CI | rerun started for job pyright - build/12346
corey: rerun came back red for me. I'll start a bisect tomorrow unless someone can take it today. my hunch is the stubgen/stubs change in the deps matrix.
maya: If corey's offline later, @jen can you take the bisect? Also note that adding `--no-incremental` to pyright/mypy helped in a previous cache-related flake.
jen: I can pick it up now. will clear caches and try a local repro first — will post steps and results in ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
ci-bot: CI | rerun finished - failed - see build/12347
jen: Quick repro steps I used: `PYRIGHT_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/pyright-cache` cleared and `yarn workspace kvcache test:typecheck` reproduced the same error. Repro script I ran:
```
rm -rf /tmp/pyright-cache && yarn workspace kvcache test:typecheck
```
Starting git bisect now and will ping here if/when I find the first bad commit.
sam: Thanks — if bisect points to stubgen or a published stub change we should pin the offending package in our CI matrix and open a rollback or compat PR.
corey: :thumbsup: i'll hold any other typecheck-related merges until we have the bisect result.
jen: update in 20 — found a likely culprit range, continuing bisect.
